name: Plato-Bio
rationale: Plato-Bio (Stefan G. Creadore, sole author, Eldergenix repo) is a biology-routed extension of the open Plato/Denario architecture with NO shared authorship with Denario (arXiv 2510.26887). It is an independent third-party derivative, not an alias — no change to asa-denario. Plato-Bio itself is not added this cycle: single-author derivative without independent adoption evidence; watchlist.

name: Argonne multi-agentic atomistic simulation framework
rationale: Crossref: Digital Discovery paper (Vriza, Kornu, Koneru, Chan, Sankaranarayanan) shares NO authors with the ChemGraph paper (Pham, Tanikanti, Keçeli) — different Argonne team, distinct system, so no ChemGraph amendment. The framework itself is not added this cycle: unnamed system, primary pages (RSC, anl.gov) 403-blocked, no repo or artifact verifiable from primary sources today. Watchlist with reconsider-when: primary page or official repo becomes fetchable.

name: MadAgents (v3) / Agentic Re-Casting
rationale: No existing MadAgents record exists in the catalog (grep verified), so there is no alias question. arXiv 2607.22813 (Diefenbacher, Plehn, Schiller, Schmal) is a method demonstration of agentic SFitter re-casting referencing MadAgents.v3, with a physicist in the loop and no located code release. Method paper without released system artifact — not added; watchlist.
